summary: Frontend testing for Quotes/Purchase Orders redesign - ALL FEATURES WORKING. Tested: 4 sidebar menu items, route-based navigation, QuoteBuilder redesign with product catalog and quote panel, Agregar duplicate behavior, product detail modal, cart functionality, and save quote workflow.

minor.issue: Price filter uses min_cost/max_cost params which filter by cost field, not by price (PVP). This may be intentional but could confuse users expecting price filtering.
